My Deer Spot — Texas deer season, week by week, all year.
Season dates: TPWD Outdoor Annual 2026–27 · Rut dates: TPWD white-tailed deer breeding-date study, by ecoregion · Live: National Weather Service · Imagery & topo: USGS The National Map · Score minimums: Pope & Young, Boone and Crockett, Texas Big Game Awards. Rut stages are estimates from breeding dates — deer on your place may run a week or two either way. Always check your county’s rules in the TPWD Outdoor Annual before you hunt.
Change log
  • Rev 1.2 (Oct 19, 2026) — The Etsy order number no longer shows on screen.
  • Rev 1.1 (Oct 16, 2026) — Real photo covers, your own cover photo option, and a 4-digit unlock code on each buyer’s copy (the last 4 digits of their Etsy order number).
  • Rev 1 (Oct 16, 2026) — First edition: magazine cover, 48-week guide, rut report for 8 Texas regions, 2026–27 season clock (North & South Zone), satellite & topo map, stand pins with wind picker, live wind and front alerts, legal shooting light, best movement times, Brag Board with antler score calculator and share cards, buyer name stamp.

Show It Off — Free
🏆 Texas Big Game Awards — free entry. Scored entries need a certified TBGA or Boone & Crockett scorer; first-harvest and youth entries need no score. Entries must be postmarked by March 1.
🏹 Pope & Young Club — archery records; typical whitetail minimum 125.
📘 Boone and Crockett Club — all-time records; typical whitetail minimum 170.
